verses.en: When Allah's succour and the triumph cometh

verses.ar: وَرَأَيۡتَ ٱلنَّاسَ يَدۡخُلُونَ فِي دِينِ ٱللَّهِ أَفۡوَاجࣰ ا
verses.en: And thou seest mankind entering the religion of Allah in troops

verses.ar: فَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ وَٱسۡتَغۡفِرۡهُۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابَۢا
verses.en: Then hymn the praises of thy Lord, and seek forgiveness of Him. Lo! He is ever ready to show mercy
